title: Detailed toothbrush
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Handle -->
  <rect x="44" y="30" width="12" height="60" rx="6" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
  <!-- Handle highlight -->
  <rect x="46" y="32" width="4" height="56" rx="2" fill="#81D4FA"/>

  <rect x="44" y="62" width="12" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#29B6F6"/>

  <rect x="44" y="82" width="12" height="8" rx="5" fill="#0288D1"/>

  <rect x="46" y="18" width="8" height="16" rx="3" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
  <!-- Brush head -->
  <rect x="38" y="4" width="24" height="18" rx="6" fill="#E0E0E0"/>

  <rect x="40" y="6" width="20" height="14" rx="5" fill="#FAFAFA"/>

  <rect x="46" y="5" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#CE93D8"/>
  <rect x="50" y="5" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#CE93D8"/>
  <rect x="54" y="5" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#CE93D8"/>
  <rect x="58" y="5" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#CE93D8"/>
  <!-- Bristle row 3 -->
  <rect x="42" y="8" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#F48FB1"/>
  <rect x="46" y="8" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#F48FB1"/>
  <rect x="50" y="8" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#F48FB1"/>
  <rect x="54" y="8" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#F48FB1"/>
  <rect x="58" y="8" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#F48FB1"/>

  <ellipse cx="50" cy="1" rx="9" ry="3" fill="#B3E5FC"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="0.5" rx="6" ry="2" fill="#E1F5FE"/>
  <!-- Sparkle on toothbrush head -->
  <path d="M62 3 L63 5 L65 3 L63 1 Z" fill="#FFF59D"/>
</svg>
